## Description
Brief summary of the changes made to the bioinformatics lab or workflow.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue or formula error)
- [ ] New feature (new interactive calculator, module, or decision tree)
- [ ] Documentation update (scientific references, explanations)
- [ ] UI / Accessibility optimization (dark/light mode, mobile responsive)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the zero-dependency vanilla web standards.
- [ ] All scientific formulas and algorithmic parameters match peer-reviewed literature.
- [ ] All embedded scripts pass syntax validation (`node` syntax checks).
- [ ] Tested both Light and Dark themes.
